question: How should a forecast combine actuals and a scenario (project_with_scenario)?
options: add scenario to run-rate | replace run-rate with scenario | actuals to date then scenario
decision: both modes: add (actuals + run rate + scenario, default; budget forecast) and replace (scenario is the whole plan)
